jobs.title: Senior Clinical Scientist - Toxicology & Mass Spec
jobs.description:
ACTalent is seeking a Clinical Scientist II in California to oversee complex laboratory testing, with a strong focus on toxicology and mass spectrometry. The role emphasizes accuracy, regulatory compliance, and staff supervision within a regulated lab.Responsibilities include final review of results, QA/QC monitoring, and ongoing staff training to ensure state licensing and CLIA standards are met. This on-site position requires meticulous scientific rigor and safety adherence.We are looking to fill the Senior Clinical Scientist - Toxicology & Mass Spec position at ACTalent in Santa Rosa, CA, United States.Please review the full job details above before applying.If your experience matches this role, we encourage you to apply.All applications are reviewed carefully by our team.The position is based in Santa Rosa, CA, United States.This opportunity is part of our work in Bio & Pharmacology & Health.
Qualifications
This on-site position requires meticulous scientific rigor and safety adherence
Responsibilities
The role emphasizes accuracy, regulatory compliance, and staff supervision within a regulated lab
Responsibilities include final review of results, QA/QC monitoring, and ongoing staff training to ensure state licensing and CLIA standards are met
